description: This file defines the LeaveRequestService class responsible for managing leave request operations, including status changes, workflow permissions, and event dispatching within the OrangeHRM leave management module.

classes.name: LeaveRequestService
classes.description: Service class providing methods for managing leave requests, workflow permissions, status updates, and event notifications within the OrangeHRM leave management system.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestDao
methods.description: Lazy instantiates and returns the LeaveRequestDao object used for data access related to leave requests.

methods.name: _changeLeaveStatus
methods.description: Internal method that updates the status of a list of Leave objects, handling entitlement adjustments when cancelling or rejecting leaves.

methods.name: _notifyLeaveStatusChange
methods.description: Internal method to dispatch appropriate events (approve, cancel, reject) based on the workflow action.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestAllowedWorkflows
methods.description: Retrieves permissible workflow actions for a given employee, leave type, status, and logged-in employee.

methods.name: isLeaveRequestActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific leave request action is permitted for the current user on the given leave request.

methods.name: generateIncludeRolesForLeaveWorkflowByEmployee
methods.description: Determines roles (e.g., 'ESS') to include in workflow permission checks based on whether the user is viewing their own leave.

methods.name: generateLeaveStatusByLeaveType
methods.description: Prefixes leave status with 'LEAVE TYPE DELETED' if the leave type is marked as deleted.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestActions
methods.description: Returns possible actions (approve, reject, cancel) for a specific leave request.

methods.name: changeLeaveRequestStatus
methods.description: Changes the status of a leave request and distributes corresponding events.

methods.name: changeLeaveStatus
methods.description: Changes the status of a single leave and triggers event notifications.

methods.name: changeLeavesStatus
methods.description: Changes statuses for multiple leaves and associated leave requests, dispatching corresponding events.

methods.name: groupLeaves
methods.description: Groups leaves by their leave request ID for batch processing.

methods.name: getDetailedLeaveRequests
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a list of leave requests, aggregating leave details.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestsMap
methods.description: Creates a mapping of leave requests by their ID for quick access.

methods.name: getAllLeaveStatusesAssoc
methods.description: Caches and returns an associative array of all leave statuses.

methods.name: getLeaveStatusNameByStatus
methods.description: Returns the name of a leave status given its integer code.

methods.name: getLeaveStatusByName
methods.description: Returns the integer code of a leave status given its name.

methods.name: getLeaveStatusesByNames
methods.description: Converts a list of leave status names to their corresponding codes.

methods.name: getDetailedLeaves
methods.description: Prepares detailed leave objects with associated leave request data for display or processing.
